title: Founder Runtime Approval Application Authority Grant Handoff Acceptance Capture Boundary
goal: Plan and validate the approval application authority grant handoff acceptance capture boundary without enabling live acceptance capture, writes, execution, providers, dispatch, mutation, network, or spend.
safetyRules: Do not capture acceptance or accept handoff in P127.1.
Do not create DB/runtime records, schemas, migrations, or hosted DB writes.
Do not call providers/models, dispatch agents, execute workers/tools, mutate projects, deploy, release, export, package, use network calls, or spend.
Do not expose DemoApp, raw JSON/logs/policy dumps, raw private IDs, raw SQL, or fake runnable actions in primary UX.
Preserve Chat with NEXUS and Lite cleanliness unless a scoped UX subphase explicitly allows a change.
reuseCheck: Reuse os-roadmap/updatePhaseStatus.js patterns when status helpers are needed.
Reuse existing dashboard cards/routes/tests; do not duplicate UI components.
Reuse existing evidence/activity/audit/cost terminology; do not create new appenders in P127.1.
commandCenterUx: P127.1 adds no UI. Existing P126.5 scoped read-only acceptance UX stays on Business Build and Agent Flow only.
costImpact: No provider calls, model calls, network calls, runtime execution, deploy/package creation, or provider spend.

subphases.title: Acceptance Capture Boundary Contract / Policy
subphases.narrowGoal: Create the P127 implementation-grade contract, seven-subphase split, safety rules, docs, status handoff, and checker while keeping acceptance capture blocked.
subphases.dataShape: Contract/status/report evidence only. No runtime exports, schemas, acceptance capture records, DB write shapes, provider envelopes, dispatch packets, or project data.
subphases.commandCenterUx: No new cards, routes, controls, or dashboard source/test changes. Preserve existing scoped P126.5 acceptance boundary UX only.
playwrightTests: Run existing scoped P126 acceptance route regression test; do not add or change dashboard tests in P127.1.
checkerUpdates: Update P126.7 checker to accept P127.1 handoff.
subphases.docsRoadmap: Create P127 plan, update README, platform roadmap, OS status, P126.7/P127.1 reports, OS report, and validation coverage report.

stamp P127/P127.1 status with the implementation commit
